RICHMOND, CALIFORNIA, August 11, 2026 
Community Services Building
440 Civic Center Plaza 
Richmond, CA  94804 
 
_____________________________________________________________________ 
 
A. 
SPECIAL OPEN SESSION TO HEAR PUBLIC COMMENT BEFORE CLOSED 
SESSION 
The Richmond City Council Special Open Session was called to order at 6:00 p.m. by 
Mayor Eduardo Martinez. 
B. 
ROLL CALL 
Present: Councilmembers Soheila Bana, Jamelia Brown, Claudia Jimenez, Sue Wilson, 
Cesar Zepeda, Vice Mayor Doria Robinson, and Mayor Eduardo Martinez.  Absent: 
None. 
C. 
CLOSED SESSION 
C.1 
PUBLIC EMPLOYEE APPOINTMENT (Government Code Section 
54957.6) 
· Title:  City Manager 
D. 
PUBLIC COMMENT BEFORE CLOSED SESSION ON ITEM(S) LISTED ON 
THE CLOSED SESSION AGENDA ONLY 
Cordell Hindler gave comments in person regarding Item C.1 (employee appointment). 
E. 
ADJOURN TO CLOSED SESSION 
The Open Session adjourned to Closed Session at 6:01 p.m.  Closed Session adjourned at 
7:48 p.m. 
F. 
SPECIAL MEETING OF THE RICHMOND CITY COUNCIL 
The Special Meeting of the Richmond City Council was called to order at 7:59 p.m. by 
Mayor Eduardo Martinez. 
G. 
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE TO THE FLAG 
Mayor Martinez led the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag. 
H. 
ROLL CALL 
Present: Councilmembers Bana, Brown, Jimenez, Wilson, Zepeda, Vice Mayor 
Robinson, and Mayor Martinez.  Absent: None. 
I. 
STATEMENT OF CONFLICT OF INTEREST 
None. 
J. 
AGENDA REVIEW 
None. 
K. 
REPORT FROM THE CITY ATTORNEY OF FINAL DECISIONS MADE 
DURING CLOSED SESSION 
Interim City Attorney Shannon Moore stated that no final decisions were made.

L. 
PUBLIC COMMENT ON CONSENT CALENDAR ITEM ONLY 
Cordell Hindler gave comments in person. 
M. 
CONSENT CALENDAR 
Motion by Mayor Martinez 
Seconded by Councilmember Zepeda 
To approve Item M.1 (Bob Murray & Associates contract amendment). 
Ayes (7): Councilmember Bana, Councilmember Brown, Councilmember Jimenez, 
Councilmember Wilson, Councilmember Zepeda, Vice Mayor Robinson, and Mayor 
Martinez 
Passed (7 to 0) 
 
M.1 
Contract Amendment No. 2 with Bob Murray and Associates for 
Recruitment Services 
APPROVE a second amendment to the contract with Bob Murray & Associates to 
conduct recruitments for specialized positions, increase the payment limit by 
$100,000 for a total payment limit of $168,000, and extend the contract term 
through June 30, 2027 - Human Resources (Nickie Mastay/Sharrone Taylor  
510-620-6602). 
N. 
ADJOURNMENT 
There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 8:03 p.m., in memory of 
former East Bay Regional Park District Assistant General Manager Jerry Kent and 
longtime Richmond resident Ernestine Martin, to meet again on September 15, 2026, at 
6:00 p.m. 
 
 
 
 
 
Pamela Christian, Clerk of the City of 
Richmond 
 
Eduardo Martinez, Mayor

agenda_briefs.title: Proposed: Council to approve $168K recruitment contract extension with Bob Murray & Associates
agenda_briefs.summary: Council is set to vote on a second amendment to the city's contract with Bob Murray & Associates for recruitment services. If approved, the contract would be extended through June 30, 2027, and the payment limit would increase by $100,000, bringing the total to $168,000. The amendment supports the City Attorney recruitment and additional executive-level searches, with anticipated costs of $28,000 to $38,000 per recruitment. This is a proposed decision and has not yet been approved.
agenda_briefs.action_required: No action needed from business owners at this time. Watch for the council decision if you provide recruitment or HR services to the city.

key_dates.label: Proposed contract extension with Bob Murray & Associates ends (if approved)

minutes_briefs.title: Council approved $100,000 contract increase for Bob Murray & Associates recruitment
minutes_briefs.summary: Council approved a second amendment to the city's contract with Bob Murray & Associates for recruitment services. The change raises the payment limit by $100,000, bringing the total allowed spending to $168,000, and extends the contract term through June 30, 2027. The firm helps the city recruit for specialized positions. This is an internal city purchasing decision, so it does not create new rules or fees for local businesses.

key_dates.label: Bob Murray & Associates recruitment contract term ends
